drive_intake.label: Manual PDF intake (Admin/Intake)
drive_intake.notes: Folder id points at Admin/Intake on the Shared Drive. Drop VIC PDFs in the VIC child (or as VIC/{TICKER}.pdf). Do not point this at the VIC child itself or ensure-folders nests Admin/VIC inside VIC.

investment_wisdom.label: Licensed books and curated wisdom extracts
investment_wisdom.notes: Drop authorized book PDFs under Research Sources/Investment Wisdom/{author}/. Do not use Letters/ or Admin/Intake. Commit text extracts in the vault; do not put licensed PDFs in the operational repo.

manager_meetings.label: Magis manager meeting PDFs
manager_meetings.notes: Canonical PDFs live in research-vault/manager-meetings/. Mirror to Shared Drive Manager Meetings/{YYYY-MM-DD}/. Do not use Admin/Intake.

notes: All PDFs route into one Shared Drive. Letters go under Letters/{YYYY Qn}. Books go under Research Sources/Investment Wisdom/{author}. Ticker VIC/research/company/activist PDFs go through drive_intake (Admin/Intake). Manager meetings use manager_meetings. Do not mix those four.
